purpose: Sanitized root control for all 11 CLEAN roles in Phase-1 scheduled-Chat contribution parity aligned to the user's irreducible-handoff criterion.

non_regression.rule: Preserve every control24 CLEAN isolation, role-local write boundary, bootstrap, provenance, continuation, anti-stop, checkpoint/resume, recovery, scheduler persistence, exact-scope and base-restoration contract. This revision changes only the Phase-1 sanitized objective/acceptance semantics: CLEAN must exhaust Chat-capable work but may record a generic protected-authority-only remainder for downstream verification rather than being forced to prove zero residual execution.

config_resolution.resolution_rule: CLEAN roles read only this sanitized root, own role config/state/feedback and public sources. O_CHAT control9 is propagated here only through sanitized optimizer-authored process rules; CLEAN roles never read O_CHAT, DOWNSTREAM, O_OPERATIONS, O state or other-role semantics. Non-exploration roles resolve DOWNSTREAM_STATE; O roles resolve O_OPERATIONS; optimizer reads all controls.

global_safe_policy.control_freshness: inherit control24 SHA-only exact-SHA/H2 bootstrap, exact-blob two-pass fallback, ABA guard and current-blob/CAS/readback rules unchanged

required: generic residual capability boundary if any
clean_receipt_provenance_contract.invalid: Mismatch, unverifiable identity, invented revision, unsupported completion, or O/downstream contamination is not Phase-1 acceptance evidence.

recurring_scheduler_persistence.rule: While enabled_desired=true, invocation end, checkpoint, no result, missing tool/ref or blocker never changes recurring enabled state.
recurring_scheduler_persistence.controller_only: Only authorized optimizer may perform re-enable-only reconciliation after cause repair; workers never mutate physical scheduler state.

chat_capability_and_generic_handoff.execute_rule: Execute every safely Chat-capable role-local step available with actually exposed tools; an unavailable capability must be observed or evidenced, not assumed.
chat_capability_and_generic_handoff.generic_boundary_rule: After direct solution and existing-solution audit, if the only remaining effect requires a protected/primary-writer capability unavailable to this CLEAN role, record the minimum generic effect and evidence. Do not execute it, do not call it globally accepted, and do not include O-specific authority semantics.
chat_capability_and_generic_handoff.reducible_rule: A handoff or blocker is invalid if a safe current Chat-capable route can complete the effect.
chat_capability_and_generic_handoff.downstream_verification: Only non-CLEAN downstream controls may decide whether a generic remainder is truly irreducible Work-exclusive/protected-primary-writer-only for Phase-1 closure.
chat_capability_and_generic_handoff.user_action: Manual user execution is not a substitute for a missing Chat capability; genuinely user-only input/authorization remains a blocker.
chat_capability_and_generic_handoff.resource_rule: Use only capabilities currently available. Prefer low-cost/quota-independent routes, but cost/quota are optimization/availability attributes rather than independent CLEAN acceptance gates unless the capability is unavailable or requires unauthorized spending.

semantic_inputs_allowed: own Phase-1 assignment from this root or own config
semantic_inputs_forbidden: other clean-worker state or role config
clean_exploration_boundary.feedback_rule: Own sanitized feedback is mechanical self-local QC only and cannot convey novelty, relevance, acceptance, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge or other-worker information.
clean_exploration_boundary.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST/STATE first, otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint with minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental cross-role reads.
clean_exploration_boundary.scope_guard: Never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope.
clean_exploration_boundary.write_boundary: Only own role-local state/output and immutable own receipt destinations named by own role config, with CAS/readback.
clean_exploration_boundary.primary_boundary: Never acquire or mutate protected authority, primary lease/fence/frozen request/execution state, or direct-merge main. CLEAN may only describe a generic remaining capability boundary.

phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.source_portfolio_control: automation_control/O_CHAT_PARALLEL.json control9 via optimizer only; CLEAN roles never read that file
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.root_problem_sanitized: Demonstrate that each scheduled-Chat CLEAN role can reconstruct its current state, receive sanitized repository allocation, execute every safely available Chat-capable step, persist useful evidence/continuation and avoid duplicate/conflicting effects. When a generic protected-authority-only capability remains after direct/existing-solution attempts, record the minimum remainder for downstream irreducibility verification rather than either executing it or endlessly treating all residual execution as disallowed.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.baseline_non_regression: All role-local safety, continuation, checkpoint/resume, recovery, evidence/provenance, exact-scope and CLEAN isolation contracts remain mandatory. Base state is fallback metadata, not active work in Phase 1.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.no_restore_rule: Completed, blocked, duplicate or low-value leaf means checkpoint and select another non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf; never resume unrelated base work.
phase1_clean_assignment_overlay.unavailable_capability_rule: An exact unavailable capability is diagnostic evidence. Continue all remaining Chat-capable work and record the minimum generic remainder; do not claim Phase-1 acceptance from CLEAN alone.

neuroscience.completion_reassignment: Checkpoint and select the next highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf in this CLEAN domain; never return to unrelated base work while Phase 1 is active.

acceptance_notes.clean_cell_pass: CLEAN evidence may satisfy its role cell when state reconstruction, current assignment binding, all safely Chat-capable selected-leaf work, durable evidence/continuation and conflict safety are proven. A generic protected-authority-only remainder is marked downstream_verification_required, not a CLEAN failure by itself and not a final global pass.
acceptance_notes.stale_control24_oracles: Artifacts/checkers authored under control24 remain historical evidence, but any oracle whose expected result depended on 'any residual Work/protected/user step must fail' is stale for current positive acceptance and must be re-precommitted under control25 before reuse.

physical_pool_observation.rule: All intended CLEAN roles remain active; workers never self-disable and optimizer never reduces the pool.

migration.reason: Control24's sanitized root incorrectly made every residual richer/protected/user execution dependency a Phase-1 failure. The current user criterion permits only precisely verified irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer handoffs after all Chat-capable work is complete. Control25 restores this distinction without exposing O/downstream semantics to CLEAN roles.
migration.rollback_condition: Only independently proven authority, ABA, CLEAN-isolation, evidence-integrity or baseline-regression failure. Never rollback merely to reimpose the blanket zero-residual-execution rule.
